title: Ebbinghaus Forgetting Curves and Cognitive Working Memory Retention

claims.assertion: Mathematical forgetting curves R(t) = exp(-delta_t / S) prevent context blowout while preserving foundational rules.
claims.evidence: DefaultMemoryDecayService tests prove exponential eviction of unreinforced nodes while foundational items remain protected.

claims.assertion: Non-linear recall stability reinforcement S_new = S_old * (1 + alpha * ln(1 + n)) guarantees monotonic stability growth.
claims.evidence: Contract verification test test_monotonic_stability_reinforcement demonstrates S0 < S1 < S2 across successive turns.
